visibility: In our search for boxing and kickboxing gyms around Shoreditch, Paragon appeared first, with more reviews at 5.0 than any other gym in the results. Your Google profile shows full opening hours (Monday to Thursday 7am–9:30pm).
lead: The only gym nearby with a perfect 5.0 across more than 200 reviews.
Reviews keep praising the beginner courses (Level 1 to Level 3) and the free taster session.
Members name their coaches (Stuart, Lisa, Sarah), which builds trust with newcomers.
A real story: founded in 1997 by a kickboxing world champion and his brothers.
lose: Larger gyms nearby offer more disciplines under one roof (MMA, BJJ, Muay Thai), which can attract people who want variety.
Some competitors open on Sundays; Paragon is closed on Sundays.
Gyms with kids' classes are visible to parents looking for youth training.

actions.title: Make the free taster bookable in one tap
actions.why: Many reviewers say the free taster is what got them started. Putting the next dates and a booking button front and centre turns interest from your reviews into first sessions.

actions.title: Tell the 1997 world-champion story
actions.why: Few gyms have a founder story like yours. A short section with Stuart's background and the coaches gives newcomers a reason to choose Paragon over a bigger gym.

actions.title: Show course dates and prices clearly
actions.why: Beginners want to know when the next Level 1 starts and what it costs before they commit. You can post this on your Google profile and Instagram today.
